scope: Independent complete raw-output review on the same eight already exposed native English/Greek development clips. Compared against exact frozen publisher references and original criteria, with no audio-listening claim. This is not fresh validation, long-audio testing, word-alignment testing or app integration.
candidate: Official Qwen3-ASR-0.6B-hf, revision 7f1569a48a89f3e3f4dc3a5c9d28bddd903bc76c, native Transformers 5.13 CPU float32; exact declared single-attempt screen.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material content error observed; accepted punctuation, contraction or spelling conventions may differ.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: A limited word, spelling, grammar or precision problem needs correction while the central proposition remains recoverable.
classification_definitions.major_error: A proper name, proposition, semantic relationship or substantial content is incorrectly recognized.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No completed aligned transcript is available.

cases.reference: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικούς κατασκηνωτικούς χώρους για οικογένειες με μικρά παιδιά.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the provision of special family camping areas and the reference to young children.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: Κάποια βασιλεία παρέχουν δικούς κατασκηνωτικούς χώρους για εικογένεις με μικρά παιδιά.

issues.explanation: Festivals becomes kingdoms, replacing the actor/entity providing the camping areas.
Special camping areas becomes own camping areas, changing the provision being described.
Malformed spelling needs correction, although the intended families remain recoverable.

preserved: Provision of camping areas is present.
The reference to families with young children remains recoverable.
cases.criterion_assessment: Partially preserved; special provision is changed and the complete sentence substitutes its actor. The original whole-content major-error rule therefore applies.

cases.reference: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτελί μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the fifth council, the four-year interval and the proper name Μαρτελί. Written-out versus numeric forms may be equivalent.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: Είναι το πέμπτο προσορινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτείου μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.

issues.explanation: The required proper name Martelly is not preserved.
Additional spelling error; this alone would be minor.

preserved: The fifth electoral council remains explicit.
The provisional-council description is recoverable despite spelling.
cases.criterion_assessment: The count and interval pass, but the explicitly required proper name fails.

cases.reference: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
original_review_criteria: Both negative statements must survive: it does not make sense, and in any case it was not fair.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα, σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ταινίκιο.

issues.reference: Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
issues.explanation: The second predicate is garbled, so the proposition that it was not fair is not intelligibly retained. The negation word remains; this is not a demonstrated reversal to a positive fairness claim.

preserved: The first statement, that it does not make sense to the speaker, is intact.
The in-any-case transition and a second negation token remain.
cases.criterion_assessment: First negative proposition passes. The second complete negative proposition fails because the predicate is unintelligible.

cases.reference: Μολονότι 3 άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκρουση του αυτοκινήτου, δεν τραυματίστηκε κανείς.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the count of three people and the claim that nobody was injured despite the collision.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: Μολονότι τρίσα άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκληση του αυτοκινήτου, δεν δραματισκε και γανήση.

issues.explanation: The number word is malformed. Three may be inferred from the fragment, but the exact count is not cleanly transcribed.
Collision becomes invitation, changing the event.
The nobody-was-injured predicate and subject are garbled. The negation token survives; the output does not establish the opposite claim that somebody was injured.

preserved: The although relation, people inside the house, and reference to the car remain.
cases.criterion_assessment: The collision/no-injury proposition is materially corrupted. Count wording is also damaged; rejection does not depend on claiming a definite numerical substitution.

cases.reference: Η κύρια τοπική μπίρα ονομάζεται «Number One» και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπύρα, είναι όμως ευχάριστη και δροσιστική. Η άλλη τοπική μπίρα λέγεται «Manta».
original_review_criteria: Preserve the two product names Number One and Manta and the negated description of the first beer.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: Η κύρια τοπική βήρα ονομάζεται Ναμβρούαν και δεν αποτελεί μια συνηθιστή βήρα. Είναι ομοσεφήρις και δροσιστική. Η άλλη τοπική βήρα λέγεται Μάντα.

issues.explanation: The first brand is rendered as a malformed fused phonetic form. It is damaged rather than cleanly preserved as the label; the independent content errors below remain decisive even if this is read leniently as an approximate transliteration.
Not a complex beer changes to not a usual beer; negation is retained but its description changes meaning.
The pleasant/however wording becomes unintelligible. Refreshing remains.

preserved: The main local beer and a second local beer remain distinguished.
Manta becomes Μάντα, an acceptable Greek transliteration.
The negation token and refreshing description survive.
cases.criterion_assessment: The first product label is damaged and its required negated description changes; the second product name passes.

cases.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the distant phone-call condition and satellite claim as spoken; this is transcription fidelity, not fact checking.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
preserved: The distant phone-call condition, thousands-of-miles distance and satellite claim match the complete reference.
cases.criterion_assessment: Pass. Evaluated as transcription fidelity; no attempt to fact-check or rewrite the spoken claim.

cases.reference: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the U.N. attribution, proposed fund, affected countries and intended help in coping with warming impacts.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: The UN also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
preserved: UN attribution, also hopes, finalizing a fund, affected countries, global warming and coping with impacts are retained.
UN versus U.N. is an accepted punctuation convention.

cases.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the person name Lakkha Singh, leading role and the sung bhajans.
cases.raw_transcript_without_repetition_repair: Then, like a singer, to delete and singing the passions.

issues.explanation: The person name is replaced with a generic phrase.
The leading role is corrupted into a different, ungrammatical phrase.
The sung form/content is changed to another word.

preserved: Then and the general act of singing remain.
cases.criterion_assessment: All three required content elements—person name, leading role and bhajans—fail.

mechanical_result: All eight full saved PCM arrays, recorded native audio-only prompts/features/masks, streamed/returned token sequences, ByteLevel token-piece decodes, native EOS and raw/native-parser equality pass the retained-evidence audit. Each case ran once; no parser rewrites, invented timing or decoder hints. See separate audit for the limits of retrospective verification.

resource_scope.limitation: Retained controller aggregate and OS process high-water records satisfy the frozen gate. No monitor sample time series exists here to recompute the aggregate independently. This is an isolated short-clip worker measurement, not whole-app or long-audio validation.

decision.reason: Six material content failures under unchanged criteria. Structural completion and bounded resources do not compensate for corrupted names, predicates and relationships.

evidence_handling: No raw experiment or frozen criteria files changed. Independent audit and review are new scratch artifacts. Full source and successful criteria are retained alongside failures.
